title: 2027届实习生
description:
广东崇立律师事务所2027届实习生招聘（仅深圳）
【单位简介】崇立律师事务所是一家全国领先的公司化精品律师事务所，专注于证券合规及投资并购。在具体业务领域里，崇立尤其以上市公司信息披露、证券合规调查、证券争议解决、兼并和收购等板块的法律服务著称。经过多年的发展，崇立凭借其专业分工和团队合作优势，已成功服务于众多行业的上市公司、大型国有企业、金融机构、民营企业以及初创企业。
【招聘岗位】实习生（以留用为目的），5人，仅深圳。工作地点：深圳市龙岗区坂田街道雅星路8号星河双子塔东塔27层2701A、2706号。到岗时间：2027年春节后到岗。实习补贴：150元/全勤工作日。
【任职要求】本科法学专业；已通过司法考试或法考成绩已出；成绩优秀；认真负责；对资本市场业务有兴趣；文字功底扎实。
【简历投递】简历发至dengziwen@chonglilaw.com，邮件主题“2027+同济+个人姓名”。简历截止2026年12月6日；2026年12月20日前完成面试并发放实习offer。
【联系方式】李诗梦（综合部/管理合伙人），电话18002503660，固话0755-89585892。

title: AI营销咨询实习生
description: 岗位职责1. 辅助AI营销架构师对接工业品、消费品生产型企业客户，整理客户营销转型需求，收集客户业务相关资料（生产链路、渠道模式、客户群体等），协助梳理需求要点，参与需求分析会议，做好会议纪要，为AI营销架构搭建、方案撰写提供基础支撑。2. 协助优化AI营销工作流，整理百度智能云、腾讯企点营销云、阿里妈妈等国内主流AI营销平台及工具的应用资料，辅助搭建客户及公司内部AI营销知识库，整合工具应用经验、案例素材，助力知识复用，配合完成知识库的更新与维护。3. 辅助制定工业品、消费品生产型企业AI营销策划方案，参与方案调研、素材收集、内容整理工作，协助统筹方案落地的基础执行事项，跟进项目进度，整理落地过程中的相关数据和问题，及时反馈给导师。4. 协助调研适配生产型企业的AI营销工具，整理工具选型资料、功能对比表格，辅助搭建公司标准化工具矩阵，参与工具应用培训的前期准备工作（整理培训素材、协助组织培训），跟踪工具迭代信息并做好记录。5. 辅助为客户提供AI营销转型咨询相关支撑，整理转型路线图基础资料，协助指导客户搭建AI落地相关组织架构的基础工作，整理岗位职责、协作流程等相关文档，协助解决落地过程中的基础难题。6. 协助搭建客户AI营销数据监测体系，整理监测数据，辅助完成复盘分析报告，协助优化营销方案及公司服务流程，支撑客户决策与公司业务优化。7. 跟踪AI营销行业趋势、竞品动态及生产型企业营销转型相关资讯，整理资讯素材，配合公司业务拓展，协助参与客户对接、方案宣讲的前期准备工作，完成导师交办的其他相关工作。8. 承担AI培训辅助工作，协助整理培训课件、梳理培训流程，配合组织内部员工及客户的AI营销工具、相关知识培训，做好培训签到、纪要记录、课后反馈收集等工作，助力培训顺利落地。9. 负责公司公众号、官方网站、各类图文平台及短视频平台的推广辅助工作，协助撰写推广文案、整理图文素材、剪辑简单短视频，发布推广内容并跟踪基础数据，配合完成平台运营及推广目标。任职要求1. 在校大三、大四学生，市场营销、计算机、人工智能、广告学、工商管理等相关专业优先，能保证稳定实习时长，服从导师安排，具备良好的职业素养。2. 对AI营销、数字化营销有浓厚兴趣，了解AI基础原理，初步了解工业品、消费品生产型企业的业务逻辑（生产链路、渠道模式等）者优先，愿意主动学习AI营销相关知识和工具。3. 了解至少1种国内主流AI营销平台或工具（百度智能云、腾讯企点营销云、阿里妈妈等），具备基础的办公软件操作能力（Excel、Word、PPT），有基础数据统计分析能力者优先；了解Python、RPA、SCRM等工具者加分。4. 具备良好的文字撰写能力、沟通协调能力和逻辑思维能力，能独立完成基础的资料整理、文档撰写工作，积极配合团队完成项目相关事宜。5. 具备较强的学习能力、责任心和抗压能力，对AI营销咨询行业有热情，愿意主动探索行业知识和工具应用，严守商业机密。6. 加分项：有AI营销、数字化营销相关实习经验；有Python、AI工具相关认证；熟悉生产型企业营销场景；具备基础的方案撰写、PPT制作能力；能熟练运用Excel进行数据整理和简单分析。

title: Technical Support Specialist Intern - French speaking
description:
About Formlabs
A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.
Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.
That’s what we do.
At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, and NASA.
Our Services team keeps those printers running. We help direct customers, distributors and resellers across EMEA resolve technical issues, investigate machine errors, analyse printer logs and get the most out of their Formlabs ecosystem.
Your Impact:
As our Technical Support Specialist Intern, you’ll be at the heart of our technology. You’ll diagnose machine errors, analyze printer logs and work hands-on with hardware, firmware, software and materials to find the root cause of complex issues. This is a highly technical role where your engineering mindset and language knowledge are put to work every day.
What makes the role special is the combination of deep technical problem-solving and real human connection. Our customers are mainly engineers, dentists, jewelers and manufacturers who rely on Formlabs printers every day.
The Job:
Respond to technical and product inquiries from direct customers, distributors and resellers in the EMEA region by email, chat and phone.
Troubleshoot printer, material and software issues, guiding customers step by step to a fix.
Review printer logs and error reports to find the root cause of problems.
Document every case clearly in our ticketing system so the team can pick up where you left off.
Escalate complex cases to senior specialists and our global engineering team, and follow them through to resolution.
Help resellers deliver great service to their own customers.
Get hands-on with Formlabs printers in the office to reproduce issues and test solutions.
About You:
Currently studying engineering.
Fluency in French and English (at least C1 level).
Technically curious and comfortable learning how hardware and software work — don't worry, we'll provide all the product training you need.
A natural problem-solver with a structured, step-by-step approach to troubleshooting.
Patient, friendly and a great listener, comfortable speaking with customers on the phone.
Able to work at least 20 hours / week
Bonus: a passion for 3D printing or hands-on experience with a 3D printer.
We Offer:
Catered lunch at the office 3 days / week
Free 3D prints
An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues
Hands-on technical training on the full Formlabs product ecosystem.
Real experience supporting customers across the EMEA region alongside an expert team.
You don’t need to check every box to apply for a role. If you love working with hardware, spending time with smart people, solving hard problems, and winning, we want to hear from you.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here. Please give them a read.
Your personal data is processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy. If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights under applicable privacy and data protection laws, please contact us at privacy@formlabs.com.

description:

Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. Coinbase’s Application Security team is rethinking how offensive security works. Reproduce and verify reported vulnerabilities across common classes (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25), and write findings that engineering partners can act on.

They are responsible for deal making and partners management from A to Z. Starting with sourcing stakeholders who could become partners tomorrow, to implementing the partnerships per se, all the while working to ensure successful, long-lasting relationships with all the stakeholders.
The difference you will make:
You’ll be joining the team at a particularly exciting moment : we’re building our local strategy from the ground up, about to launch a major partnership, and driving an innovative new project. You’ll get 360° exposure to business development, with a strong focus on activation: event execution, stakeholder alignment, and impact tracking. It’s an opportunity to contribute to a high-impact launch, learn what great outcomes look like, and build the foundation to engage future partners with confidence.
You can expect to:
Partner with your mentor - Business Development Lead for France and Benelux - to oversee activation plans for ongoing partnerships
Contribute to event coordination: this involves planning, stakeholder management (both internally and externally), D-day activation, and last but not least, after-action review to guarantee solid measurement practices, feedback collection and suggest improvements
Participate in mapping out potential new partners in the region: you will turn into an investigator to seed out ideas for new partnerships to develop our business
The intern experience:
As an intern, you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our incredible employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during your internship. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our product, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel.
Your expertise:
We welcome any candidate who is passionate about building long-lasting and effective partnerships! You are probably the right person for this role if you tick the following boxes:
You are in your final year of getting a Master’s degree
No preference for the area of study, but you have to be data- and tech-savvy
Ideally, you have previous experience in working in some partnership capacity. You were/are part of the student committee and stroke deals with the local partners for the benefits of your fellow students? We want to hear from you!
You speak both French and English very fluently (you don’t have to be a native speaker, but you need to be comfortable with both languages)
Based in Paris (this position requires in-person office presence, but our Paris office is absolutely gorgeous)
Desired Skills
Strong communication skills - Good knowledge of French market preferred
Skilled user of Excel/Google Sheets
Strong analytical skills and ability to derive high-quality analysis from data.
Ability to work proactively and results-driven: always trying to learn that extra detail that can help make the most accurate decisions
Experience with an internet marketplace business or within the travel industry is a plus
Curiosity is your driver, you are an avid learner and default to connecting with people to hear their story.
You are an authentic “people person” with the ability to connect the right people together. You default to thinking strategic and long-term rewards rather than only tactical, short-term success
Comfortable working with ambiguity

title: Product Design (Mechanical Engineering) Co-Op
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About Samsara Hardware Engineering:
Samsara's hardware systems bridge the gap between the rapidly evolving world of physical operations and our cloud platform that enables our customers to increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations which power the global economy. The hardware footprint is big – we build ultra-low power sensors, ruggedized asset trackers, vehicle ADAS systems with AI/ML, telematics systems, and rackmount video inspection with AI/ML, with more to come in the future. We leverage myriad technologies including injection molding, sheet metal, precision optics, gaskets and seals, thermal materials, adhesives, and more. Our challenges range from ingress sealing, thermal management, structural analysis, and drop and vibration survival to material selection, design for manufacturability, tooling optimization, and cost reduction, all in products built to survive extreme environments.
About the role:
We're looking for a Product Design (Mechanical Engineering) co-op to join our team. In the day-to-day, you will be responsible for working on the mechanical aspects of the design of products based on thorough feasibility, design, and cost studies encompassing enclosure architecture, materials selection, thermal management, sealing, etc. We have a tremendous amount of telemetry and access to customers that help guide our design process. You will work directly with our customers to ensure we lead the industry with our product design. We run a collaborative process working closely with Product Management, EE, FW, EPM, NPI, and Hardware leadership to make excellent tradeoffs and choices. Throughout this process, you'll share your expertise with other engineers. The US and Taiwan PD teams are supported by the Supply Chain team, laboratories, JDM design resources, and a growing supply base. You will work closely with these internal and external partners to achieve our objectives.
This role will be held at our San Francisco office. Co-ops are required to be in the office Tuesdays to Thursdays and remote work days on Mondays and Fridays. As part of the co-op program, we do provide relocation and housing support for the duration of the co-op. To be eligible for this role, you must be attending a university that supports full-time work as part of a 6-month co-op OR attend a university that will allow you to take 2 quarters or one semester off to work a co-op. Please do not apply if you are unable to commit to the full duration of this co-op. We are looking for this co-op to join us from January - June 2027. At this time, we are not accepting first-year co-op students. Ideally, this student is in their junior year of school as an undergraduate student and has previous internship and/or co-op experience.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.
In this role, you will:
Contribute to shipping successful product lines.
Conduct research: Stay informed of the latest materials, manufacturing processes, and mechanical technologies from top suppliers and manufacturing partners.
Know the system: Evaluate system feature tradeoffs and create the system specifications for development with product management and cross-functional engineering teams.
Prototype: Build proof-of-concept models using 3D printing, CNC machining, or quick-turn fabrication for evaluating concepts or jump-starting product development.
Design: Take a concept from industrial design intent through detailed CAD, part and assembly design, and production drawings, spanning enclosures, wiring harnesses and cable assemblies, and product packaging; either on your own or navigate the process with JDM resources.
Test: Create a validation plan for each phase of the product development through PVT and characterize the full mechanical system for ingress protection, drop, shock, vibration, thermal, and environmental performance.
Get hands-on: Install, evaluate, and troubleshoot our products on real vehicles and industrial equipment to understand mounting, cable routing, and real-world use conditions.

Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. The Product Management team at Rubrik drives the company’s vision forward, ensuring we continue to secure the world’s Data, AI, and Identity by delivering on our market-leading platform to address our customers’ most challenging data management & security needs. Our Product Managers are responsible for guiding multidisciplinary teams towards the goal of shipping high-quality products on time. title: Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern (Masters/PhD) - Summer 2027
description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is passionate about protecting the integrity of multiplayer games and creating a fair experience for players. We work across low-level systems, software protection, and security research to help protect the legitimacy of players’ games.
As an Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern, you’ll work with experienced Vanguard engineers on a summer research project exploring how agentic AI is changing the effectiveness of software obfuscation and virtualization. With mentorship from the team, you’ll use and improve research harnesses that iteratively challenge code-protection techniques, measure the boundaries of AI-assisted reverse engineering, and investigate methods for making protected code more resilient to AI analysis. Research and evaluate techniques that make software obfuscation and virtualization more resilient to AI-assisted reverse engineering.

Contribute improvements to shared research tools and workflows, and present progress and findings to engineers and technical partners.

Experience with agentic AI tools or harnesses used to automate iterative workflows such as code generation, testing, analysis, or evaluation.
Foundational understanding and relevant coursework in operating systems, computer architecture, compilers, and software security.

title: Data Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
description:
Riot’s Data Engineers build tools and data products that help teams understand and improve the experience of players worldwide. They work across data pipelines, data modeling, data infrastructure, and data quality to make large-scale data useful, reliable, and accessible.
As a Data Engineering Intern, you’ll work with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, analysts, and game or product partners to build and improve data products. You’ll gain exposure to transforming raw data into clean, queryable datasets, designing data models, validating data quality, and supporting data pipelines. You’ll be supported by experienced team members as you learn Riot’s tools, systems, and engineering practices.
Potential Responsibilities:
Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, analysts, and game teams on data-focused projects.
Transform raw data into clean, documented datasets that can be queried and used by downstream partners.
Implement small data pipeline, data modeling, or data-quality tasks using established tools, templates, and technical guidance.
Support the design of relational data models and data products for game, product, or business use cases.
Help validate data for accuracy, timeliness, completeness, and sustainability.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, team rituals, and project planning.
Document technical proposals, implementation details, and data definitions clearly.
Learn how cloud, distributed-processing, and data-pipelining systems support Riot’s games and products.
Required Qualifications:
Graduating in the 2028 calendar year.
Currently enrolled in a Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical degree program.
Available to work full-time hours for the 12-week internship duration.
Comfortable programming in Python or Java.
Understanding of data structures and algorithms.
Familiarity with SQL and relational data concepts such as tables, keys, normalization, or indexing.
Minimum GPA of 2.5.
Desired Qualifications:
Currently enrolled in a graduate-level (Master’s or PhD) Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical degree program.
Experience developing a data pipeline, data model, database project, or data-driven application through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects.
Familiarity with cloud-computing basics, such as AWS or GCP.
Experience working with Linux operating systems.
Understanding of distributed systems, concurrent programming, or distributed data processing.
Familiarity with tools or frameworks such as Databricks, Spark, Flink, Hive, Kafka, Airflow, Luigi, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, Parquet, or Avro.
Experience with Scala, C++, Golang, or another programming language.
Familiarity with software development practices such as Git, unit testing, functional testing, or continuous integration and deployment.
Portfolio, website, GitHub, or other collection of original work.

title: Strategic Sourcing Intern
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions
TL;DR: This is a 12-week summer 2027 internship on the Tech Sourcing team in Coinbase's Source to Pay (S2P) group, covering software, SaaS, AI, and cloud spend. You'll run analysis projects that turn vendor and renewal data into clear recommendations, and support live sourcing work.
The Source to Pay (S2P) team manages Coinbase's full third-party lifecycle, including strategic sourcing, third-party risk management, procurement-to-pay, and travel and expense. We serve as the primary point of contact for vendors across every category, partnering with cross-functional teams to keep processes clear, efficient, and compliant. Tech Sourcing manages non-human-powered spend: software, SaaS contracts, AI, and cloud. This is a hands-on internship where you'll contribute to real operational work that helps Coinbase scale safely and sustainably.

Lead a SaaS optimization review: find overlapping tools, spend, renewal dates, and usage, then recommend consolidation or right-sizing.
Build renewal readiness briefs for selected upcoming renewals, covering owners, notice deadlines, spend, usage, and open questions.
Research vendor pricing: compare pricing models, usage units, commitments, and overage exposure across several usage scenarios.
Support live sourcing work, including vendor research, quote comparisons, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
Work with the BPO team to find process delays and test practical fixes.
Support RFP and RFQ development and proposal evaluation, and keep desktop procedures and internal documentation accurate.

Currently pursuing a degree in finance, business, legal studies, or a related analytical field
Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment
Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and deliver on commitments
Analytical mindset with the ability to dissect problems, analyze data, and make data-driven recommendations
Genuine interest in Coinbase's mission and the future of digital assets
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality

title: Animation Art Intern - Summer 2027
description:
As an Animation Artist Intern at Riot, you will bring champions and characters to life through classic animation principles and body mechanics. You will create high quality animations for a diverse and rapidly growing universe, including bipeds, quadrupeds, and creatures. A great reel will showcase a variety of body types, a diverse selection of action oriented game-related animation, and a strong foundation in the principles of animation, including weight, anticipation, and impact. Also working to expand our current content pipeline, you will collaborate with designers and artists to develop new features and technologies. Your craft expertise will breathe life into iconic and beloved characters for players.

Teamfight Tactics
As an Animation Artist Intern on Teamfight Tactics, you will animate a large variety of things, ranging from champions (old and new), creatures, and even props! Your animations will have to consider how to synthesize both animation principles and the needs of strict gameplay requirements. Throughout development you will be hand-keying/editing animations in Maya, learning about League’s proprietary game engine, and implementing assets within the Unreal Game Engine. Throughout the internship you will have an onboarding partner and a team supporting you through our set development.
League of Legends
As an Animation Artist Intern on League, you will focus on champion animation. You will collaborate with animators on character lore, their motivations, and incorporate their core identity with project requirements to create impactful character performances. Throughout the process you will have an onboarding partner and a mentor to guide you through our development process.

Create high quality animations for a diverse and expanding universe, including bipeds, quadrupeds, and monsters

Collaborate with designers and artists to create animation assets that fulfill the requirements of the project’s game and visual design
Recognize areas of opportunity and help other animators level up to AAA-title-standards
Consistently meet project deadlines in a timely manner without compromising artistic integrity
Balance craft and product feedback with a strong empathy and focus on player value
Consistently communicate by proactively collaborating, directing next steps, and providing clear goals and outcomes to your team

Currently enrolled in a college, university or non degree program
Available to work full-time hours for 10-12 weeks
Authorized to work in the U.S.
Experience with action and combat based animations showcasing locomotion cycles for characters and creatures of diverse shape and size (bipeds, quadrupeds, etc.)
Experience with Maya

title: Motion Graphics Art Intern - Summer 2027
description:
As a Motion Graphics Artist Intern at Riot, you'll take the player experience to the next level by creating high-quality motion graphics for our gameplay and systems. Your technical skill for motion and compositing will breathe life into the game, transforming static scenes into powerful moments for players. You will collaborate with other artists and designers to establish how assets and UI elements will respond, transition, and increase player immersion.
In your application, you will select which product you prefer to apply to:
League of Legends
As a Motion Graphics Artist Intern on League of Legends, you’ll help bring player-facing UI and product experiences to life across in-game and around-game features. title: Operations Intern
description:
Why join us
Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
The Brex Internship Program
Throughout this 1–2 year program, you'll be placed within one of our G&A teams, learning about areas such as risk management, finance, automation, and data analysis. You'll contribute to critical process improvements and developments, implementing our processes while leveraging AI to streamline workflows and enhance decision-making.
You'll challenge the status quo and improve cross-team communication and efficiency. We believe in a founder mindset — and this program is designed to show you how you can take ownership of your growth. During this program, you'll complete a core project focused on key data insights, process implementation, or process improvement—many of which will involve exploring and applying AI solutions. You'll then have the opportunity to share your findings with your program class and Brex Executives.
The program is supported by our leadership team, and you'll have frequent meetings with various Brex leaders. This provides a unique opportunity to work closely with and learn from executives who are at the forefront of building an AI-native company.
Responsibilities
Handle day-to-day tasks efficiently.
Analyze business inefficiencies and propose process improvements to leadership, leveraging AI to drive solutions.
Work cross-functionally with various teams to streamline processes and create AI-powered workflows that improve automation and decision-making.
Collaborate with EPD, G&A, GTM, and Legal to translate business needs into practical automation solutions.
Contribute to the long-term strategy for Brex's AI-native roadmap, exploring and integrating new tools and frameworks to enhance internal operations.
Requirements
Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree with graduation between December 2027 - December 2028.
Demonstrated experience using AI tools and applying effective prompting skills.
Strong problem-solving abilities and comfort working through ambiguity.
Passion for business operations, internal tools, and the application of AI and automation to improve efficiency and enable scale.
Proven ability to work both independently and in cross-functional teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly and effectively.
Desire to contribute in a fast-paced environment with a founding team member mindset.
Where you'll work
This role will be fully remote based in São Paulo. There will be some training required in our São Paulo office.
Bonus Points
Major, minor, or coursework in a field relevant to AI and data, such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Information Systems, or other Engineering.
Basic knowledge or proficiency in programming languages such as but not limited to Python, JavaScript, or SQL.
Experience with personal projects, a portfolio of work, or participation in competitions (e.g., Hackathons) focused on AI, machine learning, or data analysis.
Leadership roles in university clubs or organizations related to data science, AI, computer science, or business analytics.
Prior internships in an operational, data, or technical role, especially where you were involved in process improvement or automation.
Familiarity with Retool, Salesforce, Hex, and Looker.
Please be sure to submit all CVs/resumes in English
Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

title: Global Sourcing Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
Do you want to change how the world creates?
At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.
We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.
Your Impact:
The components we source from all over the world are essential to the success of our products and company. We must carefully balance our need to lower costs while ensuring high performance, reliability, and abundant supply. You’ll work with our team of engineers to build relationships with suppliers and expand the capabilities of Formlabs to directly improve our products. If you are focused and inspired with a passion for streamlining and optimization, we want you as a Global Sourcing Intern on our Global Sourcing Team.
Internship Term: Summer 2027 (May/June - August)
Commitment: Full-time
Location: Onsite in Somerville, MA
The Job:
Work directly with current and potential suppliers to keep our material pipeline flowing
Develop strategies to better optimize our suppliers for cost, quality, and supply resilience
Assist in supply chain planning for future product rollout
Conduct market analysis to provide deep and meaningful sourcing insights
You:
Have a technical or engineering background
Excited to source, contact, and evaluate potential suppliers for quality, reliability, cost and capacity
Able to work with a variety of teams, communicating effectively in-person and remotely
Organized and focused, able to handle concurrent conversations and projects, documenting progress along the way
Leadership experience and exposure to project management
Bonus Skills (Optional):
Manufacturing and procurement experience
Advanced use of Microsoft Excel
Product development experience
Familiarity with part inspection and corrective action, i.e. Quality Control
Experience with the manufacturing technologies used to make our printer parts: injection molding, machining, sheet metal stamping, bending, and forming, SMT etc.
Intern Benefits & Perks:
Flexible Out of Office Plan – take time when you need it
Salaried bi-weekly pay schedule
Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
Catered on-site lunches (3x per week), snacks, beverages, & treats
Cohort-based social and professional development experience for interns
Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
And of course… unlimited 3D prints
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.
Compensation:
Interns at Formlabs are paid on a bi-weekly pay schedule. The pay range for this role will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, location and expected impact on the organization. This is a salaried role, so you will always be paid based on the assumed 40 hours per week as a full-time intern. This position does not offer housing or relocation assistance.

$1,575—$1,950 USD

title: Electrical Engineering Co-Op
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About Samsara Hardware Engineering:
Samsara's hardware systems bridge the gap between the rapidly evolving world of physical operations and our cloud platform that enables our customers to increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations which power the global economy. title: Sales Engineering Intern, Summer 2027
description:
Internship Dates: June 1, 2027 - August 20, 2027
About Rubrik
Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. For more information, please visit www.rubrik.com and follow @rubrikInc on X (formerly Twitter) and Rubrik on LinkedIn.
The Rubrik SE Philosophy
At many companies, a SE is a demo-bot. At Rubrik, SEs are strategic influencers. We don't just answer technical questions, we shape the required capabilities a deal comes down to. We don't just show features, we build champions. We don't just solve tasks, we connect Rubrik's value to the problems that keep a CIO up at night.
About Rubrik’s Internship Program
Rubrik offers interns an opportunity to make an impact from day one. Our interns work on challenging projects, where their contributions help solve real-world problems related to personal privacy, business continuity, and digital safety. Interns learn from the best in the industry, building connections with senior team members who support their development through 1:1 mentorship. Alongside the meaningful work, interns are fully immersed in Rubrik's inclusive community through social events, networking opportunities, professional development workshops, and volunteering events.
During the internship, you’ll have access to:
Meaningful projects: The opportunity to translate your education into hands-on professional experience through rigorous, yet rewarding work
Growth and development: Take advantage of extensive growth opportunities through mentoring, job shadowing, workshops, lunch n’ learns, and hands-on project work that supports both your personal and professional development.
A dedicated manager & mentor: A team that will provide you with guidance and support regularly
Intern events: The opportunity to participate in networking events, volunteering opportunities, and social events
Other perks: Access to free mental health services, lunch stipend, optional 401K benefits, company-wide intern presentations, intern swag, and more!
What we do matters. Join us and unleash your potential!
Program Structure
Over 12 weeks, you'll move through three phases:
Phase 1 – Foundations (Weeks 1–4): Tech Sales 101, presentation skills, 365 skills, and shadowing SEs on live calls.
Phase 2 – Your AI Project (Weeks 5–7): Plan, build, and internally present the AI project you'll carry into your capstone.
Phase 3 – Show What You Know (Weeks 8–12): Shadowing Professional Services and Support, live role plays, and your Capstone Showcase in front of SE leadership.
Every week follows the same rhythm: A Monday team meeting, a weekly 1:1 with your mentor and SE director, and open-ended shadowing whenever a call or POC is happening.
Your Capstone Showcase in Week 12 has two parts; a polished, customer-ready demo or presentation delivered to SE leadership, and a presentation of your AI project covering the problem, your solution, and its impact.
What You’ll Do
The Discovery Journey, learn to ask the hard questions that uncover a prospect's real business pain.
Champion Building, work alongside our field teams to identify and equip technical stakeholders with what they need to advocate for Rubrik internally.
Master the Plan, build a functional understanding of how top-performing SEs design campaign execution strategies that win.
Cross-Functional Impact, collaborate with Account Executives, Sales Leaders, and Specialist Teams to drive outcomes.

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree
Graduating in December 2027 or Spring 2028
Available to work full-time for a 12-week program in Austin, TX
Comfortable presenting and thinking on their feet in a live, unscripted setting
Basic technical fluency — enough to speak credibly about how a product works and field follow-up questions, not necessarily deep engineering depth. This could also be an aptitude to learning new things, we will teach the tech
Prior customer-facing experience (support, sales, TA roles, tutoring, campus ambassador programs)
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, virtualization, or data protection/security concepts
Experience with AI/ML tooling specifically, given the project component
Public speaking, debate, or case-competition background

The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

title: Strategy & Operations Intern 2027 (USA)
description:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
As a Strategy & Operations Intern on Pinterest’s Global Content Organization (GCO), you’ll support business planning, performance analysis, and scoped operational projects. You’ll turn data into clear insights, track progress against team goals, and identify practical ways to improve how work gets done.
What you’ll do:
Analyze business and operational metrics to identify trends, summarize findings, and explain performance against defined goals.
Build or improve a recurring report or dashboard for a focused set of metrics; document metric definitions and refresh steps.
Support team planning and goal-setting by organizing inputs, maintaining a milestone tracker, and surfacing open questions and dependencies.
Coordinate a scoped team project by tracking milestones, documenting decisions, and preparing concise status updates.
Review a routine workflow and recommend a practical improvement, including the expected benefit and suggested next step.
Use Pinterest-approved AI and internal tools, where appropriate, to support research, analysis, and workflow improvement; validate outputs, use sound judgment, and follow responsible-use guidance.
What we are looking for:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, a related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience analyzing data to identify trends, answer defined business questions, and communicate clear takeaways.
Experience using spreadsheets, reports, dashboards, or similar tools to organize, analyze, and present information.
Ability to bring structure to ambiguous questions, identify relevant inputs, and develop practical next steps with manager guidance.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when tracking milestones, documenting decisions, and maintaining project materials.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to share concise updates and collaborate effectively with relevant stakeholders.
Ability to use AI to improve the speed and quality of relevant research, analysis, or workflow outputs while validating accuracy and quality.
High integrity and ownership when using AI and internal tools, including protecting sensitive data, following responsible-use guidance, and remaining accountable for final deliverables.
In-Office Requirement:
We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
For this role, all interns will work in a hybrid model (commutable distance to one of our offices, with in-person collaboration approximately 1–3 times per week). Specific location(s) will be confirmed during the interview and offer process.

This position may be eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

title: Software Engineering Internship - San Francisco
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
At Samsara, interns can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, an intern may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.
On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.
Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.
Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.
You should apply if…
You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
You want to build for scale. You'll work on technology that powers physical operations at a scale most engineers never experience.
You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You’ll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.
Minimum requirements
Currently a junior-year student on track to complete a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or Data Science between Spring/Summer/Fall 2028 or Winter 2029.
This internship is hybrid: 3 days per week in our San Francisco, CA office. Relocation assistance is available.
This internship is a full-time, paid experience - interns are expected not to be enrolled in school full-time while working at Samsara.
In your application:
Include your resume
Answer all of the application questions
We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, and we expect to finalize our cohort by late November/early December. Applications will officially close on November 26th at 11:59pm (ET). Please do not email us to inquire about the status of your application.
We know that applying for internships can be time-consuming, and we truly appreciate your effort. We’re looking forward to learning more about you through your application.

$61.90—$61.90 USD

title: Product Design Intern
description:
About Stripe
Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.
Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.
About the Team
Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. In this role you will be part of the Product Design team, which is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about.
What You'll Do
As a Product Design Intern, you will focus on designing and building experiences that will be shipped to our users in production. You will contribute design iterations to ongoing project workstreams, tackling important projects to increase global commerce, and help shape brand new experiences. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.
Key responsibilities include:
Work on a product design project with a product team, translating business ideas into real experience.
Help craft thoughtful experiences that enable startups and large businesses to establish and manage their businesses.
Apply problem-solving skills and human-centered approaches to address complex and ambiguous business and user problems.
Develop and refine design solutions by partnering closely with other designers.
Craft and prototype visually polished experiences to get user feedback.
Partner closely with engineering to implement a feature/product from design to implementation, and get it in the hands of our users.
Engage in group design critiques and collaborative design sessions to improve and receive feedback on your work.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, data scientists, and researchers, proactively seeking and incorporating feedback.
Understand and advocate for our users, participating in the design process from early concepts to final delivery.
Who You Are
Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.
Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.
Minimum Requirements
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a design-related field, such as UX/UI, Interaction Design, Human Interface, Computer Science, HCI, or a related discipline.
Some experience using computer programs to design, such as Figma/Canva.
Demonstrated experience designing experiences and user flows.
Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and best practices.
Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, form an understanding through independent research, and effectively work with a mentor and teammates.
Are a self-motivated problem solver committed to personal growth.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate work while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.
Ability to participate in a paid full-time internship between May–August, 2027.
Preferred Qualifications (A bonus, not a requirement)
Previous project, internship, or work experience in UX/UI design or related fields.
Experience working with or conducting your own research, presenting results, and acting on those results.
Experience with AI tools like Cursor, Lovable, V0, or any others.
Strong knowledge in design craft and visual d

title: PhD Intern, Software Engineer - Interaction Design (2027)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
Figma’s Interaction Design team helps designers express how interactive experiences behave from a single interaction, to a multi-state flow, to a series of complex animated transitions. We’re interested in making complex interactive behavior easier to author, refine and understand. This team investigates and identifies new ways to visualize and manage state, animations, interactions, and prototypes through click-through and code-backed experiences.
As a PhD intern, you’ll combine HCI research with hands-on-engineering to help define the next generation of interactive experience design tooling. You’ll work closely with a mentor and teammates and get to learn, contribute, and grow in a supportive environment, while applying your research background to drive real-world impact.
This 12 or 16-week internship for Summer 2027 will be based out of our San Francisco or New York hub.
What you’ll do at Figma:
Be fully embedded onto a Figma team working on problems that intersect with your research area
Drive projects that apply research insights to meaningful product challenges
Collaborate with engineers, PMs, designers, and researchers to scope and execute your work
Develop, validate, and document solutions from prototypes to production-ready systems
Share your expertise through presentations, design reviews, and cross-functional collaboration
Deliver a project with real impact by the end of your internship
We’d love to hear from you if you have:
Current enrollment as a 4th or 5th year senior PhD student pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field
Demonstrated ability to translate complex research concepts into practical, scalable solutions
A track record of rigorous problem-solving through academic or applied research
Proficiency in at least one general purpose coding language
While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:
A creative portfolio of work consisting of time-based media, animation, game development, digital illustration, or another creative field.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience collaborating across functions
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to write, debug, and optimize code
Applied engineering skills via industry experience, prior internships or similar experience
First-author publications in top academic conferences related to our team’s focus areas

title: Product Management Intern
description:
Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience
About the Team & Role
The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.
The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.
We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.
What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)
Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.
Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.
Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.
Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.
Executive Strategy Pitch: Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap.
What You’ll Need
Education: Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28
Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus.
Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage.
Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements.
Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders.
Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model).
What You’ll Gain
True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership: Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project.
High-Stakes Leadership Visibility: Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership.
Cybersecurity PM Expertise: Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader.
Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation
Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

title: Print Production Intern (Winter/Spring 2027)
description:
About Formlabs:
A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.
Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.
That’s what we do.
At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA.
Your Impact:
As a Print Production Intern on our Sales Enablement Team, you will support our showroom and print production initiatives, including printer maintenance, SLA and SLS print production, and print farm clean-up and logistics to ensure a safe and inspiring environment to produce 3D printed solutions.
Internship Term: Winter/Spring 2027 (January 11 - April 30)
Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)
Location: Onsite in Somerville, MA (in-person)
The Job
Support on design modifications, part layout and slicing for 3D print optimization.
Support 3D print production including printing, troubleshooting and maintenance across SLA and SLS printers and all Formlabs materials.
Post process, sand and finish parts.
Support the team in space maintenance to ensure top of the line health and safety in the showroom and production spaces.
Create and identify opportunities for space improvements to optimize production, printer utilization, quality control measures, and maintenance while ensuring health and safety of the space and everyone who uses it.
You
Enjoy working independently.
Are highly organized and interested in helping streamline processes.
Have 3D printing experience and are motivated to become a 3D printing expert.
Are Able to lift 40-80 lbs.
Are eager to plug into the needs of the Sales team and the Formlabs community.
Are confident working in Excel/Google Sheets and have a knack for Project Management.
Intern Benefits & Perks:
Flexible Out of Office Plan – take time when you need it
Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
Catered on-site lunches (3x per week), snacks, beverages, & treats
Cohort-based social and professional development experience for interns
Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
And of course… unlimited 3D prints
You don’t need to check every box to apply for a role. If you love working with hardware, spending time with smart people, solving hard problems, and winning, we want to hear from you.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here. Please give them a read.
Compensation:
Interns at Formlabs are paid on a bi-weekly pay schedule. The pay range for this role will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, location and expected impact on the organization. This is a salaried role, so you will always be paid based on the assumed 40 hours per week as a full-time intern. This position does not offer housing or relocation assistance.
The weekly pay range for this role is:
$1,000—$1,150 USD

title: Ground Systems Engineering Intern Summer 2027
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB
Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.
As a Grounds Systems Engineering Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Middle River, Maryland you will have the opportunity to support the team as they design, build, and implement large tooling, fixtures, and custom lift equipment to support prototype and production of Neutron. The Ground Support Equipment engineering team designs and manufactures production, test, and transport equipment in support of Neutron build and operation.
WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO
As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally
Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges
Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates
Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events
YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS
Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results.
Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s, master's or doctorate degree program in an engineering discipline such as Manufacturing, Mechanical, Mechatronics or related discipline and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship
GPA of 3.0 or above
3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable)
THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE
GPA of 3.5 or above
6+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable)
Experience with Solidworks, SiemensNX, Creo, Catia
Experience working with hand tools
Familiar with structural analysis
Familiar with assembling mechanical structures
Computer-aided design and manufacturing (CAD/ CAM) experience
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027
COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS
Pay Rate MD: $25.00 USD Hourly
You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs
Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Employees may also receive company equity and access to a robust benefits package including: top tier medical HMO, PPO & a 100% company-sponsored medical HSA plan option, dental and vision coverage, 3 weeks paid vacation and 5 days sick leave per year, 11 paid holidays per year, flexible spending and dependent care savings accounts, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and access to a 401(k) retirement plan with company match. Other perks include: discounted employee stock purchase program, and free snacks/drinks onsite.
Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.
Base Pay Range (MD Only)
$25—$25 USD
WHAT TO EXPECT
We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.
